title: There and Back
statement: A cyclist rides $30$ km at $15$ km/h, then another $30$ km at $30$ km/h. What is her average speed for the whole ride, in km/h?
hints: Average speed is total distance over total time. It is not the mean of the two speeds.
solution: The two legs take $2$ hours and $1$ hour, so $60$ km takes $3$ hours: $20$ km/h. Equal distances give the harmonic mean of the speeds, not the arithmetic mean $22.5$.
